newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Gilt-Edged to seek Kundana purchase ok.
newsitem.headline: Gilt-Edged to seek Kundana purchase ok.

text.p: Gilt-Edged Mining NL said on Thursday it would seek sharehoder approval on June 27 to acquire a key shareholding in the Kundana gold prospect in Western Australia.

Gilt-Edged said earlier it completed arrangements with Tribune Resources NL and Rand Mining NL to acquire up to 60 percent of the prospect over the next five years, paying A$500,000 cash to gain an immediate five percent stake.
The remaining equity can be acquired by spending up to A$4.6 million on exploration and the exercise of an option, Gilt-Edged said.

"The Kundana project covers an eight km section of the Zuleika Shear, one of the most productive structures in the region as well as a 10 km section of the Kopai Gabbro, which hosts the promising White foil deposit two km to the south of the tenements," managing director Don Boyer said.
The deposit also surrounds Goldfields Ltd's high-grade Kundana mine and is an extension of the same prospective geological setting, Boyer said.

Gilt-Edged said it has A$7 million in the bank and will initially fund the acquisition with cash. The expenditure will not affect the exploration budget committed to its two primary gold projects, Siberia and Ora Banda/Christmas Reef, both in Western Australia.
An interim estimate by Gilt-Edged has put the existing resource at three locations on the Kundana tenements at 364,000 tonnes of ore, grading 2.8 g/t of gold, containing 33,000 ounces of gold.
